beats.text: Rain turned the last train into a ribbon of silver.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: Rin said midnight. She did not say why.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: You came.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: You made it sound urgent.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: It is. Someone woke the old duel transmitters beneath the arena.
The train left without either of them.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Every receiver in the district heard one challenge, repeated in a dead frequency.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: A challenge meant a duelist. A dead frequency meant a ghost.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: That face says you already want to investigate.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Or run. Running remains underrated.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Kael traced the signal. I supplied the optimism.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Two nodes answered. The archive is sealed. The arena is inviting us in.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Before we go: are you with me?
Her hand stayed open between them.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Then we choose how to step into the dark.
They crossed the empty concourse toward the river district.
Tournament posters peeled from pillars like old scales.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: I will keep the channel open from here.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: At the arena, we listen before we answer.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: That was not how challenges worked. It was how traps worked.
The arena gate opened on its own.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: If the transmitter recognizes your deck, it may stage a complete duel before it reveals who sent the signal. We can still turn back.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: Not after it called us here.
Floodlights woke one bank at a time, drawing a path to the center field.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Then remember: winning is not the only way forward.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: Easy to say before the first card hit the field.
New objective: investigate the Old Arena signal.

beats.speaker: Rin
beats.text: Pick our route. The city map is linked to the transmitter now.
Somewhere below, a duel disk powered on.

beats.speaker: Protagonist
beats.text: Whatever waited there already knew my name.

choiceResponses.challenge-rin: Rin meets your stare. “Fair. No more half-answers.”
choiceResponses.observe-first: Kael nods. “Good. You watched before you moved.”
choiceResponses.trust-rin: Rin exhales. “Then I will earn that trust.”

choices.label: I trust you. Lead the way.
Tell me what you are hiding.
We watch the signal before deciding.

laterAcknowledgments.challenge-rin: Rin acknowledges your challenge and shares the full signal trace.
laterAcknowledgments.observe-first: Because you watched first, the arena marker reveals an extra warning.
laterAcknowledgments.trust-rin: Rin remembers your trust and marks the safest route.
